152061.overview: It is the first hidden object game developed exclusively for children. Featuring hours of fun gameplay, Junior Mystery Quest takes you along a strange and exciting adventure where it is up you to solve the mystery of the Tibutton family and their missing Uncle Albert. Uncover peculiar and challenging puzzles on your quest and discover just how fascinating the life of a detective can be!

152062.overview:
Give young brains a fitness workout with this fun and innovative DS brain training product, designed to improve reading, writing, spelling, maths, geometry, logic and problem-solving skills.

Created specifically for kids aged 6-11, Junior Brain Train takes a fresh and fun approach to learning by teaching kids in "bitesize' chunks and then rewarding them with unlockable mini-games. The program encourages children to spend a little time each day completing 5 different activities, with a rewarding game at the end.

Using a fun and stimulating environment it's the perfect way to keep them challenged and motivated so they're actually learning without realising it. A great way to support your child's classroom studies and build confidence at school!

152063.overview:
Improve Your Math Skills In Minutes!
Sharpen your skills with fun, interactive games that promote faster learning and increased mathematic comprehension. Junior Brain Trainer: Math Edition is designed specifically for kids aged 6-11, and encourages young students to continue solving problems even after the school bell rings! Fun, captivating challenges keep kids motivated and eager to learn! Your child will be head of the class in no time!

152064.overview:
Features over 130 NEW exercises, puzzles and quizzes
2 NEW modes of play
Features 11 NEW unlockable mini-games
Supports kids' classroom studies and helps build confidence at school
Fun and stimulating gameplay keeps kids challenged and motivated
Suitable for ages 6-11

152065.overview: In this game, players take on the role of a teacher of 8 different students. Player can choose to be either a male or female teacher. As the teacher, players have to schedule two classes a day for four days a week, with the school subjects of things like math, history, and gym classes for the students to attend. The classes play out as mini-games. For example, the math class makes the player draw over writing on a chalk board and judges the player on the cleanliness of their steadiness with the chalk. Another mini-game will have players navigating their way through a food fight in the cafeteria. The goal of the game is to have the teacher keep both their teaching skills as well as their popularity levels among the students high.

152066.overview: Three things stand between you and your children - a jungle teeming with danger, the ruins of an ancient Mayan tribe and a band of thugs - and you're not going to let any of them stop you! Take the role of Joan Jade, archeologist of the year and mother extraordinaire, as she searches for hidden objects, solves mind-melting puzzles and beats one ingenious mini-game after another. Along the way, you'll visit dozens of beautifully crafted locations, uncover a story of nail biting suspense and learn fun facts about one of the most fascinating lost civilizations on Earth.

152067.overview: In Jigapix: Wonderful World jigsaw puzzle fans take on the addictive challenge of solving 80 landscape puzzles created from picturesque and iconic images sampled from around the world. Puzzles images included in the game come from eight different regions, as well as eight different sizes, making piecing images together more and more challenging as familiarity with regions fade and the dimensions of puzzles change. Players can solve the puzzles alone or with a friend via a wireless connection, and for those needing an occasional break from jigsaw play, there are three additional mini-games included in the game. Finally, DSi owners can take the game to a whole new level as they are able to snap photos and create their own personalized jigsaw puzzles out of the imported images.

152068.overview: The world is a wild place! In JIGAPIX WILD WORLD you'll find 80 amazing images of the wildest animals, from the bottom of the oceans, across vast plains, to the deepest tropical jungles; including Apes, Big Cats, Reptiles, Birds, Insects, Sea Life and more!

152069.overview: Can you be the first to complete the puzzle in Jigapix Pets? Solve one of the 40 unlocked puzzles, or unlock 40 additional ones in Time Challenge mode. Challenge a friend in a head-to-head race to be the first to complete a jigsaw puzzle. Take a photo using the camera in your Nintendo DSi system and create your own unique puzzle to expand the fun. Jigapix Pets features 80 images of some of your favorite furry and cuddly creatures like cats, dogs, rabbits, horses and more.

152080.overview:
JIGAPIX is an exciting range of Jigsaw Puzzle games for Nintendo DS and Nintendo DSi, providing fun for all the family and game modes to suit all ages including Free Play, Time Challenge and Wireless Multiplayer.
To make things really interesting on Nintendo DSi, JIGAPIX lets you take a photo and turn it into your very own puzzle!
Love is a beautiful thing! In JIGAPIX Love is … complete puzzles covering all aspects of amour with these lovable characters. 80 specially commissioned and beautifully illustrated drawings will have you puzzling for hours. Love is …, after all, also a puzzle!

152081.overview: After answering her uncle's call, Eva Witheby winds up far from home and amidst strangers in Jewel Quest Mysteries Trail of the Midnight Heart! It's hard to know who to trust when treacherous trails and veiled secrets abound. Alongside Eva, uncover relics in eye catching Hidden Object scenes. Unearth tools that will help you reveal shards of the precious jewel boards in this exciting whirlwind adventure!

152083.overview:
In the aptly titled Jewel Quest IV: Heritage, Rupert's arch-rival Sebastian Grenard has stolen the Golden Jewel Board, claiming it as a family heirloom. In order to prove that the board is rightfully his, Rupert must trace its origins all the way back to the Aztec Empire while investigating his own family tree to see how the history of the jewel board is intertwined with the lives of his own ancestors.

Solve over 175 Jewel Quest Heritage boards and one puzzling family mystery on a topsy-turvy quest through Europe's ancient hot spots. Hit the trail with Rupert on a journey through the shrines and castles of Hernan Cortes' lore. Swap jewels and collect puzzle pieces to unravel a perplexing web of Jewel Quest family secrets. With over 175 new Jewel Quest Heritage boards, including 3 jewel-swapping modes, new surprises await in every level.

152084.overview: Rebuild the five castles of Nevernear in this amazing Match 3 adventure. Match dazzling gems across 100 inventive levels in search of keys, potions, and more. Use portals, call on wizards, learn spells, and plant magical gardens to ward off evil. Play fantastic Hidden Object and Puzzle mini-games throughout the journey. Enjoy a beautiful soundtrack along with bonus Wallpapers.

152085.overview: Let the little cares of life fade away in this mesmerizing Match 2 wonderland. Line up dazzling jewels and eliminate tiles across 150 levels of casual fun. As you progress, you`ll collect coins to purchase unique powers. Use your new abilities to break the chains that lock certain gems in place or send lightning ripping through tiles. Build majestic castles and enjoy spellbinding visuals in Jewel Match 2

152102.overview:
Having graduated top of her Biology class, Jane is sent off to Africa at the request of her University Director, to locate and study the very rare White Lion. Accompanied by four animal guides, the quest turns out to be more challenging than originally thought.

Use your match-3 and puzzle-solving skills to help Jane and friends track down the highly elusive King of the Jungle. With 3 game modes to choose from, Jewel Link Safari Quest is the ultimate African-themed match-3 adventure!

152103.overview:
Solve over 120 match-3 levels
Search 12 galactic locations
Includes 3 game modes - Swap/Chains/Group
Complete challenging mini-games
Collect powerful extras to use in your quest to save the planets

152104.overview:
Explore the ocean floor in this underwater match-3 adventure!

A tanker has capsized leaking tons of oil into the ocean! Join four marine friends in this exciting puzzle adventure to save the reef and it's underwater inhabitants. With 3 different ways to play and powerful extras to collect, use your match-3 skills to clear theur match-3 skills to clear the contaminated water before it's too late!

152105.overview:
Help Yeti and his penguin friends save their Antartic home from the ice storm
Explore 100 levels of challenging match-3 gameplay
Lead the penguin team safely through the dangers that await them
Use each penguin's skill to help you in your quest
Features 3 game modes
swap, chain and group
Cool graphics and cute penguin characters
An ice-cold match-3 puzzle adventure!

152106.overview:
The Hods, magical beings and pure of heart, once lived in harmony with the holy Tree of Life. But the endless greed of a dark demon forced them into hiding. Now, new hope springs eternal.

Using building materials, jewels and other valuables, switch two adjacent tiles to make a row of three or more matching tiles! The valuables will help you to rebuild the world of the Hods and to restore the Tree of Life to its former strength!

152107.overview: Bejeweled clone in which you match gems to fight monsters and search for lost artifacts in your mission to restore order and help save the human race.

152108.overview: Build a high tower from falling pieces of all shapes and sizes before the rising water below destroys your progress in this fun and frantic puzzle game! Jump up to catch the shape you need, rotate it and place it in your tower without leaving gaps. To win, you must reach the top before your opponent does!

152123.overview: J4G - A Girl's World is a Simulation game, developed by Snapdragon Games and published by dtp Young Entertainment AG, which was released in Europe in 2009.

152127.overview: Assume the role of Tracy and have fun guiding her through a story-driven adventure inspired by the original books. Based on the characters created by Jacqueline Wilson, the game features 5 minigames: Angels and Devils, Noughts and Crosses, Hangman, Make-Up Game and Dance Game.

152164.overview:
Bridge Training is the first Nintendo DS game exclusively dedicated to the popular Bridge game!

Bridge Training is based on the rules of the "contract bridge", which inspires enthusiasm both for beginners and professional players.With bridge training you can playfully and easily learn how to bridge with integrated lessons and exercises. Experience players can contribute their skills thanks to expert tips Bridge Trainer for the NDS even better!

features:
* More than 100 games!
* 3 game modes: normal game, against time and perfect
* Each game is commented so that the player can learn from his mistakes and constantly improve his performance
* A detailed tutorial provides an easy and smooth introduction to the world of the popular bridge game
* The integrated touchscreen notepad allows targeted elaboration of the strategies

152171.overview: Set foot into the realm of the elves, fairies and gnomes. Bring back the light into a world which lies in darkness, using the aid of your magical powers.

153871.overview:
At the beginning of the game, the player's submarine crashes in the Deep Sea. While the friendly sea serpent Jean Claude helps repair the submarine, the player must collect oxygen tanks by exploring the Deep Sea and completing activities. The oxygen chamber must reach its maximum level before the player can escape the Deep Sea.

As the player explores the Deep Sea, they must avoid pesky sea creatures. The player's health is represented by three hearts. Getting hurt by a sea creature costs the player one of their hearts. The player can jump on a sea creature to defeat it.

There are four activities, and each activity has three difficulty modes: easy, medium, and hard. There are 15 levels for each mode of difficulty. Unlocking all the levels in easy mode unlocks the first few levels in medium mode, and unlocking all the levels in medium mode unlocks the first few levels in hard mode. The player receives one oxygen tank for each level that they complete.

The player can collect a total of 21 trophies for completing activities and tasks.

The player also has an avatar that they can customize and buy clothes and accessories for at the Shop. The player can unlock new Shop items by collecting oxygen tanks.

153872.overview:
Discover a Mysterious Island!

- Explore a 3D island packed with strange creatures and hidde treasures
- Rack up points in exciting games, puzzles and challenges
- Track down helium tanks to repair your blimp and escape the island
- Bonus: Earn codes to unlock exclusive items at JumpStart.com

160331.overview:
Crayon Shin-chan is a long-running japanese manga series. It has also inspired over 50 video games, from Game Boy to Switch. Many of them have only been published in Japan, though quite a few have been also been published in South Korea, Italy and Spain.

First of the five DS games of the series, ¡Shin Chan: Flipa en colores! is a pure platformer where Shin Chan must travel through the world of dreams supported by his markers, costumes and his unique charisma, to repair the damage that a small dream-eating pig has left behind.

168219.overview:
Cradle of Rome is a tile-matching game with a classical antiquity theme. The tiles have icons of city resources, for example piles of wood, wine barrels and coins. Matching three or more of these tiles collects them to their respective resources tab.

Three resources tabs are displayed at the top of the screen for money, wood and food. As the player progresses through the game buildings become available to build, their cost being a combination of those resources.

An amphora serves as the timer, slowly leaking water as time passes. If the player manages to finish the level before it is empty, the water remaining is added as a bonus to the resources. Otherwise, the player loses a life. Some of the board surface has marble underneath it. To complete a level, this marble has to be broken by matching the tiles over it.

168467.overview:
Atlantis - Did it ever really exist?

For a milennia, adventurers have sought the sunken kingdom and its countless treasures - but who created the mystic city in the first place?

Discover the secret, create magnificent buildings and restore Atlantis to its former glory. Collect ancient artefacts and secret treasures to help you along the way. Test your Jewel-matching skills over a series of challenging levels, in this captivating, underwater puzzle game!

168468.overview: Along with Percy and a beautiful Algonquin named Yellow Feather, you will travel to exotic locations on two continents and overcome dangers at every turn, in an effort to recover the jewel. The game includes over 200 jewel board puzzles, including never-before-seen obstacle puzzles! You will progress through a beautifully illustrated and fully voice-acted story that includes collectible power-ups that enhance game strategy as well as quest options filled with your favorite classic Jewel Quest games.

179433.overview:
Jet Impulse is a flight simulation video game developed by Nintendo for the Nintendo DS. 

The goal of Jet Impulse is to defeat an evil dictator and his army of elite strike fighters. The game features customizable airplanes and weapons, as well as a co-op mode that was playable over the now defunct Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection.

180837.overview:
Crayon Shin-Chan: Obaka Dainin Den: Susume! Kasukabe Ninja Tai! is an action adventure game where players follow the antics of Shinnosuke Nohara (Shin-chan) and his friends as they form the Kasukabe Ninja Squad. 

The game involves platforming, combat, and puzzle-solving, with each character having unique abilities to navigate through various levels and overcome obstacles.

181176.overview: Crayon Shin-Chan Shokkugan! Densetsu o Yobu Omake Daiketsusen!! is a game based on the "Crayon Shin-chan" series. In this action-adventure game, players take on the role of Shin-chan and other characters as they embark on various missions and challenges. The game features a mix of platforming, combat, and puzzle-solving elements, staying true to the humorous and playful nature of the series.

181238.overview:
Shin Chan: Adventures in Cineland (Shin Chan: Arashi no Yobu Cinema - Land no Daibouken ?) is a video game released for Game Boy Advance on April 16, 2004. A remake on the DS titled Crayon Shin -Chan: Arashi o Yobu Cinema-Land: Kachinko Gachinko Daikatsugeki! was released in 2008.

In this game, Shin-chan and his family visit Cinema Land where they go through to a parallel dimension where Action Kamen is a real thing, and they must help him to beat the Haigure Mao.

182338.overview: Jaka Jaka Music! is an Action game, developed and published by Plato, which was released in Japan in 2010.

182341.overview: Jewel Pet: Mahou no DS Kirapi Kariin is a Simulation game, developed and published by MTO, which was released in Japan in 2009.

182398.overview: Jewelpet: Kawaii Mahou no Fantasy is a Simulation game, developed and published by MTO, which was released in Japan in 2009.

182399.overview: Jewel Pet: Mahou no Oheyya de Issho ni Asobou! is a Simulation game, developed and published by MTO, which was released in Japan in 2010.

182401.overview: Somewhere in the vast sea of the Internet, there's a website that can only be accessed at the stroke of midnight. Known as the Jigoku Tsushin, rumor has it that if you post a grudge there, the Jigoku Shoujo will appear and drag whoever torments you into the inferno. Very little is known about the girl - all we know for sure is that she lives with her equally enigmatic grandmother, that three magical straw dolls accompany and serve her, and that whenever a posting on the Jigoku Tsushin moves her, she becomes the Jigoku Shoujo.

182402.overview: Jinsei Game is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Takara Tomy, which was released in Japan in 2009.

182403.overview: Jishin DS: 72 Jikan is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Jupiter Corporation and published by Iota, which was released in Japan in 2009.

182404.overview: Josei no Hinkakujuku DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by PHP Interface, which was released in Japan in 2008.

182405.overview: Juggler DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Commseed, which was released in Japan in 2008.

182600.overview:
Keiji J.B. Harold no Jikenbo: Manhattan Requiem & Kiss of Murder is an Adventure game, developed by althi Inc. and published by fonfun, which was released in Japan in 2008.

24 year old pianist Sarah Shields was found dead after falling from the 25th floor of her apartment window. The cause of death was a fractured skull from the horrific impact. With no evidence of foul play, an act of suicide was the best explanation - but J.B. Harold thinks otherwise. Having recieved a letter from Sarah beforehand, the famous detective heads towards New York city to find the truth.

184520.overview: Nicola Kanshuu: Model * Oshare Audition is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Infinity and published by Alchemist, which was released in Japan in 2010.

185934.overview:
The Invaders of the untherworld 'Nenne Nesia' have begun to move. Something
shimmering that Shin accidentally picked up has created a hole for the 
exit of the invaders! The invaders began to gather in the underworld
 all over the earth! !Shin will have to go out for an adventure together
 with Colon to stop the invasion of the Nendo world!

187337.overview: Dragon Quest Monsters: Joker 2 Professional is an expanded version of Dragon Quest Monsters: Joker 2. The game follows the same story and introduces a new region to explore, as well as more than one hundred new monsters and new skill sets. Players can import the progress from the normal version and continue where they left off.

187908.overview:
Jewel Link: Galactic Quest
Help Captain Smith of the Starship Victory on an intergalactic adventure to save the planets! A massive explosion has rocked the entire cosmos - a gigantic star has gone supernova, use your match-3 skills to search galactic locations and help destroy the space debris!
- Search 12 galactic locations
- Solve over 100 match-3 levels
- Complete challenging mini-games
- Includes 3 game modes - Swap/Chains/Group
- Collect powerful extras to use in your quest to save the planets!

Jewel Link: Atlantic Quest
A tanker has capsized leaking tons of oil into the ocean!
Join four marine friends in this exciting puzzle adventure to save the reef and it's underwater inhabitants.
Use your match-3 skills to clear the contaminated water before it's too late!
- Includes 3 game modes - Swap / Chains / Group
- Solve over 120 match-3 levels
- Search 12 underwater locations
- Collect power extras to help rescue the ocean!

191148.overview: Jinsei Game DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Takara Tomy and published by Atlus, which was released in Japan in 2006.

191150.overview: Jinsei Game Q DS: Shouwa no Dekigoto is a quiz-based board game for the Nintendo DS, released exclusively in Japan on 27 December 2007. Published by Takara Tomy, it is part of the long-running "Life Game" series (the Japanese equivalent of The Game of Life) and focuses on historical events from Japan's Shouwa era.

191244.overview:
Jan Sangoku Musou (雀・三國無双) is a Mahjong game using Dynasty Warriors characters. There are no battlefields involved but there is interaction between warring generals with dialog that somewhat parodies Dynasty Warriors 5. This title is only available in Japan. Koei has no current intentions to release this in North America or Europe.

Players name their own "Mahjong warrior" from 32 preset designs and 6 different voice sets. Once the player has decided on a character, they can choose to either participate in a tournament or in one of the game's story modes. Each match in story mode has four participants, the player being set against three characters from the Dynasty Warriors series.

The rules are similar to other Mahjong games but includes cuts of the series's characters during matches. Image displays are often voiced and essentially give hints regarding the opposition's situation. These cuts sometimes include the characters posing with their weapons or displaying emotions rarely seen in the series, which makes these instances unintentionally hilarious.

The rules and scores are very similar to a form of Japanese mahjong, particularly the type that is found in competitive mahjong games and yaku. Players can still forfeit their hand and use pon, chii, riichi, or kan. Though the player is allowed to change certain rules, there are rules that remain by default.

191245.overview: Johnny no Dasshutsu Daisakusen is an Adventure game, developed and published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2008.

191615.overview: Jiji Tsuushin Shuppan-Kyoku Kyouryoku: Katei no Igaku: DS de Kitaeru Shokuzai Kenkou Training is a Japanese educational health and nutrition training game released for the Nintendo DS on 8 November 2007. Developed and published by Rocket Company, it focuses on "home medicine" (Katei no Igaku) and dietary health through interactive training.

191621.overview: This game blends education with fun. Sightsee through your Nintendo DS by putting the jigsaw puzzle together. The pictures are taken from the photo collection “Eighty selected World heritage images”. So travel around the world as you complete the puzzles.The game fully utilizes the DS functions such as making use of the two screens and the touch pen. The top screen shows the photo when the lower screen shows the jigsaws. Just drag and drop the pieces to the right place, and there are hints for you if you get stuck. The puzzles comes in different sizes, from 36 pieces to 108 pieces. Once the jigsaw puzzle is completed it is added to the picture gallery for your perusal along with an introduction on that heritage site.The inner constructions of some of the heritage sites are made into puzzles as well, so increase your knowledge while you have fun. Aside from photos and constructions, to test your geography, maps and country flags are also turned into puzzles.

191622.overview: The demon lord is back for his ultimate revenge. In almost all T.V anime, the demon lord is often found causing a ruckus happily until the heroes show up to defeat him. To extract his revenge, he summoned eight the heroes (all from popular anime) to the jigsaw world and challenge them to battles. To return home safely, these heroes need to carry all the jigsaw pieces to the field and fit them together depending on the pieces you managed to fit together, you can launch into special attack modes and destroy your opponents' work.This is a game suitable for people of all ages, make use of the Wi-Fi connection on you Nintendo DS and play with your family or friends. A maximum of four players can join in a game at the same time.This game combines educational worth with fun. There are all sorts of scenes you can form with the jigsaws, you can check out trivia information on the animals or plants depicted in the scene through a mini encyclopedia.

191669.overview: Juushin Enbu DS is a role-playing game, developed by ThinkArts and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2007.

191671.overview: Joshikousei Nigeru! Shinrei Puzzle Gakuen is a Puzzle game, developed by Skonec and published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2008.

191709.overview: Jissen Pachi-Slot Hisshouhou! DS: Aladdin II Evolution is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Sammy Studios and published by Sega, which was released in Japan in 2006.

191710.overview: Jissen Pachi-Slot Hisshouhou! DS: Pachi-Slot Hokuto no Ken is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Sammy Studios and published by Sega, which was released in Japan in 2005.

191711.overview: Jissen Pachi-Slot Hisshouhou! DS: Hokuto no Ken SE is a pachi-slot machine simulator for the Nintendo DS, released exclusively in Japan on 10 August 2006. Developed and published by Sega, it is a conversion of Sammy's popular arcade slot machine based on the Fist of the North Star anime franchise.

191833.overview: Juushinden: Ultimate Beast Battlers is a Strategy game, developed and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2007.

192236.overview: Josefiina Alkupolku: Englannin Kieli - Mysteeri Lontoossa is an educational adventure game released for the Nintendo DS in 2009. Part of the Josefiina (originally Pixeline in Denmark) franchise, the game is designed to teach English language skills to children through a mystery-solving narrative set in London.

192239.overview: Reader Rabbit: On a Mission to Help the Lion Flowers is a video game released on the Nintendo DS in 2011 developed by The Learning Company and published by Nordic Softsales and Prelusion Games. It was released exclusively in Europe in the English, French, Finnish, Swedish and Norwegian languages. The game is essentially a partial version of Reader Rabbit Learn to Read With Phonics: 1st & 2nd Grade.

197535.overview: Welcome to another sequel in the popular Jewel Quest puzzle game series. In Jewel Quest Mysteries, Rupert and Emma are plunged into the land of ancient intrigue, Egypt. Seek out treasures and jewels, hidden within stunning gardens and relic-laden palaces. Swap jewels to turn tiles gold in classic Jewel Quest boards, and decipher puzzles of logic and wit. Immerse yourself in this hidden object game shrouded in the lore of Jewel Quest and the mystique of ancient Egypt. It's challenging, fun, and addictive.

203513.overview: J'Apprends l'Anglais CP - CM1 on DS is an edutainment game for learning the language of Shakespeare from a young age. The exercises offered (pronunciation, thinking, spelling, quizzes, etc.) are presented in a fun way in order to make learning more attractive for the child, while respecting the fundamentals of the school program.

210065.overview: Get ready for Christmas karaoke where you are the star! The famous Christmas tunes “Jingle Bells” and “Silent Night” are waiting for you. Dressed up as jolly Santa Clause, enter a stage covered in snow. Just sing into the Nintendo DSi microphone and get into magical Christmas mood. While singing, receive feedback. Did you hit all the right notes and sing in time? It’s a real challenge! Compare your high score with previous singers. Just sing till your holiday heart’s content!

212242.overview: Josefine - Magi i Eventyrland is an Action game, developed and published by Krea Media, which was released in Europe in 2009.

213080.overview:
Jeoldaepiryo: Yeongsugeo 1000 DS (절대필요: 영숙어 1000 DS) is an educational Nintendo DS title released in South Korea in 2007, designed to help users master 1,000 essential English idioms.

Developed by Mechanic Arms and published by IE Institute, this title is part of the "Eitango Target" franchise. It functions as a portable "edutainment" tool, specifically targeting Korean learners of English who need to memorise idiomatic expressions for exams or general fluency.

213081.overview:
Jeoldaeuwi: Yeongdaneo 1900 DS (절대우위 영단어 1900 DS) is an educational software title released for the Nintendo DS in South Korea. 

 Designed as an English vocabulary learning tool, specifically focusing on approximately 1,900 essential words.

213082.overview:
Jewel Match + 4 Elements is a compilation of 2  games, developed by Joindots and published by Purple Hills, which was released in Europe in 2014.

Jewel Match has its own victory criterion though. On each of the 150 levels, a selection of squares have gold or even silver backings. One match (gold) or two (silver) must be created over each of these against a ticking clock to clear the level. Later in the game there are jewels tied to their square with a golden or silver chain, which thus are not falling down and blocking empty squares beneath them. These jewels can be freed by matching them once or twice, too, which means that the most difficult squares must be matched four times (silver chain and silver background) to be cleared.

A succession of hammers are unlocked once you have scored a certain amount of points. The first removes a particular jewel, the second not only removes the gem but also any effects (background or chains) on the square, and the final one removes all gems of that colour. Another extra to be unlocked is a magical storm that will have the player blow into the DS microphone to mix up the jewels. Moreover, matching more than three jewels in a row will create gems with special powers. Matching four will create a joker gem while matching five gives a gem that, once activated, will destroy the whole row it is in.

The game also offers a hot seat mode where two players can play the same level right after another, competing for the better clearing time.

4 Elements

The ancient kingdom is in peril! Evil forces have corrupted the four elements and the waters of the altar of life have run dry. Unlock the four ancient books of magic, collect 16 mysterious cards and restore the kingdom to life. Match the enchanted symbols and set the kingdom free! - Captivating Match 3 gameplay - 64 enthralling levels, plus bonus hidden object and spot-the-difference games - A beautiful fantasy world brought to life in stunning detail - Use both screens to clear a path to your goal

213143.overview:
Solve the mystery of Master Hak's disappearance!

There's trouble in Pixieland again. This time it's Pixieland's founder, Master Hak, who has disappeared. Help Pixeline find all the pages of the witch's magical cookbook, the pages are scattered all over Pixieland.

439112.overview:
Enjoy a game of billiards on the go!

Challenge intelligent computers or even your friends to a traditional game of 9-ball while enjoying mind-soothing music with Jazzy Billiards. Take advantage of the intuitive stylus mechanic to aim and hit the cue ball with varying strength to sink the other balls. Defeat your opponents by being the first to sink the 9-ball. Jazzy Billiards' Stage Mode features 9 different stages, each with an opponent of ascending difficulty. Find out how many computers you can defeat in a row with Challenge Mode, or challenge your friends to a game of 9-ball in Versus Mode.

439125.overview:
Jam Space: PocketStudio for the Nintendo DSi system puts the power of a recording studio in your pocket.

You can compose tracks, jot down ideas and be musical no matter where you are. Choose from two modes. Quick Jam mode allows you to lay down tracks quickly and easily using natural instrument interfaces. This is a great mode if you've got a little melody you want to record and want to get it down quickly.

Studio mode gives you access to a full-featured MIDI editor that lets you tweak and hone your compositions to a professional level. If you want to dig deep and really work on that masterpiece, this is the mode for you.

439140.overview:
Welcome to Jewel Keepers: Easter Island – an addictive match-three arcade action game with mind-blowing visuals and engaging storyline! This game will keep you entertained for hours, as you travel across Easter Island and help to unveil its mysteries.

More fun from Nordcurrent: - 101-in-1 Games – a collection of 101 games in one app. Frequent chart topper in USA, UK, Australia, and many other countries! - Urbanix – an enhanced version of Xonix and Qix, with new modes of play, new worlds and enemies! - Robin Hood: Return of Richard – help Robin to defeat the villains and restore peace in this action game!

Subscribe to www.youtube.com/Nordcurrent for new videos and trailers! Join us at www.facebook.com/Nordcurrent to participate in our competitions, win prizes and have fun!

439142.overview:
You'll want to drive JellyCar 2 all around town!

JellyCar 2, the hit driving platform game is here and fully loaded with more than 30 levels, three game modes, and much more! Post high scores, best times and longest jumps in the Hall of Fame. With so much squishy goodness, you’ll want to drive JellyCar 2 all around town!

Classic:

Drive your squishy car and use your special abilities to drive through squishy worlds!

Factory:

Where does all this squishy goodness come from? The Jelly Factory, of course! In this puzzle game your goal is to guide the falling parts into matching chutes. Tap the levers to open different pathways to guide each part down the conveyor belts.

Long Jump:

You’re going for distance, so go for speed! Watch out for objects that can slow you down, and look for objects that can help give you a boost!

439145.overview: It is the greatest sporting event of 2010 - the World Cup! All eyes are on South Africa, all EARS are on you - in the karaoke game of the year! Enter the hallowed turf and display your talent by singing the National Anthems! There are 5 National Anthems to choose from: Argentina, Australia, Brazil, Japan and the United States. Just sing into the Nintendo DSi microphone! So, lace up your boots and step out onto the pitch - to sing!

439168.overview:
The popular platform game Jump Trials is finally making its way to American shores this Fall.

Jump Trials is a platform game that will test your control skills to the limit. Run and jump as fast as you can across an obstacle course of platforms to reach the goal within a 10 second time limit. Each stage is a different challenge with obstacles including spikes, moving platforms and conveyor belts. Fail to reach the goal within 10 seconds or touch a spike and it's game over.

There are two modes of play: Trials Mode and Challenge Mode.

Trials Mode
Test yourself over 100 stages. Starting from level 10, make your way up to level 1, completing 10 stages in each level. There is a 10 second time limit in each stage. Clear a stage by jumping on the goal switch before the time runs out. If you clear all 10 stages in a level you'll move up a level where you'll tackle more demanding stages.

Challenge Mode
In Challenge Mode you'll find three medals in each stage. The higher the value the more difficult it is to reach, starting with bronze, then silver then gold. See if you can reach all three medals and make it to the goal within the 10 second limit! You'll be awarded a bronze, silver or gold crown for each stage depending on how many medals you managed to collect. Do you have what it takes to get gold crowns on all 100 stages?

439180.overview:
Storm onto the Christmas stage and celebrate the festival of festivals with two classic Christmas songs: "O Christmas Tree" (O Tannenbaum) and "Joy to the World"!

Just sing into the Nintendo DSi microphone and enjoy the festive atmosphere. Hit all the right notes and sing in the correct tempo to reach the top of the high score list! Rise to the challenge and enjoy the Christmas cheer throughout the year!

439215.overview:
The ‘80s are back and you’re a star! Grab your Nintendo DSi system and have some ultimate karaoke fun.

You can expect all the cult hits of the era: Like a Virgin, Take On Me, Never Gonna Give You Up and The Heat Is On. Style your avatar in a classic ‘80s look, and take to the stage. Can you keep to the beat and hit all the notes?

Perform the biggest party hits of the ‘80s and experience a musical blast from the past!

- Like A Virgin
- Take On Me
- Never Gonna Give You Up
- The Heat Is On
439215.publisher: dtp young entertainment GmbH & Co. KG

439223.overview:
Jump Trials is back and this time it's gone EXTREME!

Jump Trials Extreme will test your running and jumping techniques to the limit, all over again! In this second version of Jump Trails there are new game features, new game modes and over 100 new stages to test your platform running and jumping skills.

Take control of a stickman and race across an obstacle course to get the exit in just 10 seconds! Navigate your stickman across moving platforms, slippery surfaces, disappearing blocks, conveyor belts, spring pads and seesaws! With only 10 seconds to reach the exit, hesitating for even a split second can be the difference between success and failure!

Test your running and jumping skills in three different game modes.

•Trials Mode - Test yourself over 100 increasingly challenging stages.
•Time Attack Mode - See how quickly you can complete each stage in a race against the clock.
•Challenge Mode - Collect three medals on your way to the exit before the time runs out.

439224.overview:
You're the star – prepare yourself for the next edition of Christmas karaoke! Holiday classics “We Wish you a Merry Christmas“ and “Deck the Halls” are waiting for you!

You’ll enter the festively decorated stage in a fancy Santa’s costume. While singing into the Nintendo DSi microphone you’ll immediately catch the magical Christmas spirit! Hit all the right notes and sing in time to the beat to reach the top of the highscores list!
